parameters.name: All
parameters.description: Specifies whether to delete all tags of the target resource. This parameter takes effect only when TagKey.N is empty. Default value: False.

parameters.name: ResourceId
parameters.description: The list of resource IDs. Valid values of N: 1 to 50.

parameters.name: ResourceType
parameters.description:
The resource type. Valid values:

- Job
- Executor

parameters.name: TagKey
parameters.description: The list of tag keys. A maximum of 20 subkeys can be specified.
